title: Fixture Handout: Slow Breathing Practice
intro: This is a test fixture, not clinical content. It uses “smart quotes”, an arrow → and a sign ≥ so the PDF sanitizer has something to convert, plus an emoji 🙂 that must be dropped.

sections.heading: Getting ready
sections.body: Find a quiet spot. Sit with both feet on the floor.
steps: Rest one hand on your belly.
Breathe in for a count of 4, then out for a count of 6.
